_comment: F22#4 Captain Veyra (Cloudreach summit) readability candidate. Her Crosswind Command wind lanes (cloudreach_summit_hazards.gdshader) drew at 21% alpha with no edges and melted into the summit paving in the CPU baseline. This raises the lane fill and adds a bright rim along each lane edge; lane geometry, timing, push and safe lee pockets are unchanged (presentation only). OFF until the in-world three-judge round passes.
_why_forward_plus_1024: GPU F40 fight (24 Oct): on Forward+ the wind-lane fill drew as opaque white shaft planes. forward_plus_fill_scale multiplies the fill on Forward+/Mobile only (cloudreach_summit_presentation.gd); the rim carries the lane there. Compatibility keeps fill_alpha.
